# AstryxCode { #anylumino.AstryxCode }

```python
AstryxCode(code, **props)
```

Render inline code with Astryx styling.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                        | Default    |
|---------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| code    | str    | Astryx component option.                                                                                                                                                           | _required_ |
| **props | Any    | JSON-safe Code props. Useful keys: className and style. The code text is passed as component text content. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Code>. | `{}`       |
